metadata.description:
This HDBLAST main-program update preserves three separately registered homogeneous metric-response experiments and their failures, the preceding fixed-geometry matched minimal-stress benchmark, and a completed source-free saved-data diagnostic. The original round failed a fatal continuum quadrature warning; the high-precision follow-up failed its independent memory allowance; the complete memory-only follow-up remains scientific FAIL, with 29 conservation endpoint and 30 refinement checks outside their unchanged gates. Historical verdicts are retained.

The new diagnostic was public and registered before numerical evaluation. Two independent implementations at 80 and 100 decimal digits test twelve fixed consistency cases on the interval after the source ends. All twelve consistency cases pass; eight meet the unchanged error-attribution criterion. The largest absolute Simpson conservation residual is 1.02863406e-4, compared with a largest exact-ledger residual of 1.61796600e-17. A fresh self-contained ZIP replay reproduces all scientific records and streamed endpoint-flow files. The 48,470,467-byte ZIP contains 172 payload files plus a manifest, including frozen raw inputs, code, registration, original outputs, internal reviews and figures.

All ten files inherited from version 2026.09.05-v24 are retained unchanged as historical v24 material. That earlier release establishes a conditional rank-two response for its fixed-background registered five-field linear model, under its stated model, background-root, Green/source, stability and gluing premises. It does not establish the later metric-response calibration, physical source-energy normalization, nonlinear persistence or a higher-dimensional cause of the Big Bang. The new numerical diagnosis does not upgrade or withdraw that distinct conditional certificate.

The source-free result diagnoses sampled-history time integration in this prescribed calculation. It cannot explain all 59 original metric failures or establish active-source conservation, complete momentum error, initial-state accuracy, the actual shell root/lapse/bulk/state response, coupled dynamics, stability, heating, observational confirmation or a hot Big Bang. No new law of nature or externally established mathematical novelty is claimed. Review and numerical assistance are internal and AI-assisted; this is not external peer review.

The new attachments comprise four computational benchmark/failure ZIPs, the metric failure report, the completed ledger ZIP, its measured-results report, its external fresh-ZIP replay receipt, and a version overview. Reports/data use CC BY 4.0; bundled code retains its included MIT license, and third-party material retains its included licenses. The main program concept DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.17088132. The scalar-junction/static-branch companion, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22922927, remains a separate record family.

The completed active-source follow-up is included as a separate self-contained package with the final measured-results report and an external fresh-ZIP replay receipt. Its registered classification is LEDGER_ERROR_DEMONSTRATED. The report preserves the first execution-schema failure, the publicly disclosed repair chronology, all fixed cases and controls, and every earlier scientific FAIL. Original and fresh registered full scientific frames match exactly according to the reviewed external receipt. The native source/phase arithmetic and empirical quadrature controls are distinguished from MP80/100 final reductions. This finite-cutoff prescribed calculation does not prove a higher-dimensional Big Bang origin, coupled backreaction, continuum-momentum certification or a new law of nature.
metadata.notes:
Start with HDBLAST_V25_PUBLICATION_OVERVIEW_20261002.md for this version. The inherited PUBLICATION_README.md, 00_READ_FIRST.md, DELIVERY_SHA256SUMS.txt and other ten preserved files describe historical v24 material.

The complete ledger ZIP SHA256 is b98291b7d8a2a40d5ddf79d877bb0177c03b748becc726d63a94456adc4830a0. Its HDBLAST_SOURCE_FREE_LEDGER_FRESH_ZIP_REPLAY_20261002.json receipt stays external to the ZIP it verifies. Original and fresh replay classifications are LEDGER_ERROR_DEMONSTRATED; the preceding metric calibration remains FAIL.

Publication-status text inside sealed archives records each archive's preparation snapshot. Current publication metadata must be verified from the submitted Zenodo record. Enabling the public GitHub integration does not prove that automatically generated records share this manual concept family. No GitHub release was created to test integration.

Start with HDBLAST_ACTIVE_SOURCE_LEDGER_REPORT_20261003.md for the completed active-source round. The preserved HDBLAST_V25_PUBLICATION_OVERVIEW_20261002.md describes the preceding source-free nine-attachment candidate snapshot. The complete active-source ZIP SHA256 is 0cd3dd2da604444541c06e98167f537f769c0ce430108bf02354e5090f328c4f, size 32195260 bytes, with 237 payload files plus MANIFEST.json. Its external fresh replay receipt remains outside the ZIP it verifies. Automatic GitHub archiving is OFF for all eight public repositories. The published current record23112891 contains only the ten inherited files and has no semantic-version field. The intended unpublished v25 update targets the reconciled main-family draft23114217; no test release or new standalone main record was created.
